query: SELECT id,creating_transaction_id,spending_transaction_id,lower(hex(owner)) AS ownerRaw,lower(hex(token_type)) AS tokenTypeRaw,lower(hex(value)) AS valueRaw,lower(hex(intent_hash)) AS intentHash,output_index FROM unshielded_utxos WHERE creating_transaction_id=? OR spending_transaction_id=? ORDER BY id
scope: Actual indexed public UTXO rows; raw integer/token codecs not independently interpreted here; not canonical node finality
